father.name: Dad
father.text: The quiet engineer behind the scenes.

wolfgang.name: Wolfgang
wolfgang.text: Big brother, four years ahead. Never skips leg day.

monika.name: Monika
monika.text: Big sister, nine years ahead, and voice of reason.

christine.name: Christine
christine.text: Big sister, ten years ahead, and keeper of the embarrassing stories.

valentin.name: Valentin
valentin.text: Stair seller at Bickelmann, fan of the absurd, and my first software customer.

ben.name: Ben
ben.text: University friend and 3D wizard. Built Valentin's stair software and Laxino's casino games with me, from Moscow.

podelski.name: Prof. Podelski
podelski.text: PhD advisor and mentor, with a Chair at the old Freiburg Flugplatz.

podelski_dog.name: Balzac
podelski_dog.text: Podelski's dog and the toughest reviewer in the group.

byron.name: Byron
byron.text: Podelski's termination-proof collaborator. We only really talked years later, in New York.

evren.name: Evren
evren.text: Friend since high school, driver of the old Mercedes, brunch strategist.

john.name: John
john.text: Always up for a whiteboard session.

stephan.name: Stephan
stephan.text: Fellow PhD student in Freiburg, and followed me to Macau.

zhiming.name: Zhiming
zhiming.text: Postdoc host at UNU-IIST in Macau, co-creator of rCOS. Sent me to SRI.

lauren.name: Lauren
lauren.text: Wife, co-adventurer, and owner of two bears.

willem.name: Willem
willem.text: Model-checking legend, collaborator, and eventually the boss.

paul.name: Paul
paul.text: Laxino's man in Macau. Business meetings at the gym or the bar.

tancrede.name: Tancrède
tancrede.text: SRI, then AWS. Cryptographer, co-author, and the groom at one of the weddings Martin officiated.

emmi.name: Michael
emmi.text: SRI, then AWS. Built Rapid together. Martin officiated his wedding too; nobody objected.

ioannis.name: Ioannis
ioannis.text: SRI, then AWS. Thai boxing partner after work. Still owes Martin a round.

numair.name: Numair
numair.text: Billing Science. CDM, contract drafting, and a reliable reminder to go have brunch.
